title: The Crown Prince's Awakening
next_chapter_hook: When Chen Ji thought everything was under his control, what he didn't know was—that seemingly frail Crown Prince's eyes reflected a golden vertical pupil deep within, the mark of the Heavenly Dao's Eye.

text.content: Just as Chen Ji fell into deep contemplation, that cracked Turtle Shell suddenly burst with blinding white light, an old yet familiar voice crossing through time and space—Chen Tianming's final testament to his son. The cracks on the Turtle Shell spread like spider webs, each pattern like a brand carved by the Heavenly Dao, searing Chen Ji's palm.

That voice, old yet powerful, echoed in Chen Ji's Mental Sea like great bells and massive chimes, each word carrying the weight of a thousand jun, shaking his eardrums. Yet the moment the voice fell silent, the Turtle Shell abruptly shattered into countless ashes. Chen Ji clenched his palm tightly, the scorching heat lingering between his fingers, his eyes flickering with a complex expression—that was not merely grief, but an almost fanatical obsession.

dialogue.content: In the instant the Turtle Shell shattered, it seemed as if a pair of eyes gazed upon Chen Ji from the void, their gaze cold and高高在上, as if审视着一只自以为跳出棋盘的蝼蚁。

text.content: "My son, if you can hear these words, it means your father is no longer among the living. The secrets of the Tianji Record are by no means a burden you can bear—remember, do not delve too deeply, do not..." The voice cut off abruptly, leaving only endless mysteries. Chen Ji slowly rose, tucking the remaining ashes into his sleeve, a cold smile curling at the corner of his mouth.

dialogue.content: Do not delve too deeply? Hmph, Father, you underestimate your son far too much. The more you forbid me from knowing, the more I will investigate until I get to the bottom of it.

text.content: Just then, soft knocking came from the door. A black-clad figure silently appeared at the entrance, kneeling on one knee, presenting a gilded invitation. Chen Ji unfolded it—a few sparse characters, yet enough to make the entire imperial capital's风云变色。

dialogue.content: The Crown Prince's secret summons... Interesting.

text.content: Night fell, and Chen Ji changed into a plain robe, carrying only a folding fan, walking alone into the Eastern Palace. Inside and outside the Eastern Palace, lanterns blazed, yet an oppressive tension permeated everywhere. Every lantern's position, every guard's station—all conformed to some formation—Chen Ji was secretly startled; this Crown Prince's depth of backing far exceeded his imagination.

Within the bedchamber, medicinal fragrance curled. The Crown Prince reclined on a couch, his face pale as paper, yet possessing a pair of eyes sharp as blades. His breath was faint and unsteady, clearly from unfinished recovery, but that imposing royal aura of a ruler who commanded respect without anger sent all present into an窒息般的压迫。

dialogue.content: "The Grand Tutor visits late at night; this palace has been remiss in welcoming."
"Your Highness speaks too heavily. This commoner is merely a wandering cultivator—how could I possibly deserve such courtesy?"

"A wandering cultivator? The Grand Tutor jest. One who can make three great Sects tremble with fear, who can stir the winds and clouds of this imperial capital—such a person cannot possibly be summed up by the words 'wanderer.'"

Pausing, the Crown Prince's lips curved into a meaningful smile as he slowly straightened his posture, his pale face revealing a shrewdness utterly at odds with his frail exterior. "The Grand Tutor, or should I say—Chen Ji, servant-disciple of the Tianqing Sect, am I correct?"

text.content: At these words, all the attendants in the hall were shocked. Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply, but in merely a moment, he returned to normal. He toyed with the folding fan in his hand, looking at the Crown Prince with a knowing half-smile, yet a fierce killing intent flickered in the depths of his eyes—discovered, then... But how did this Crown Prince come to know?

choice.prompt: Faced with the Crown Prince exposing his identity, how does Chen Ji choose to respond?

choices.description: Since exposed, might as well admit magnanimously, showing sincerity while probing how much the Crown Prince actually knows.
choices.visible_reward: Win the Crown Prince's initial trust
choices.risk_hint: Risk being at a disadvantage if the Crown Prince has other schemes

text.content: Chen Ji chuckled lightly, snapped his folding fan shut, and clasped his hands: "Your Highness is indeed discerning. Yes, this commoner is indeed Chen Ji. However—since Your Highness knew my identity long ago, why summon me only tonight?"

A flicker of appreciation appeared in the Crown Prince's eyes: "Because this prince was waiting. Waiting for you to prove yourself worthy of this prince's personal intervention." He clapped his hands, and the palace doors suddenly opened. A troop of black-armored imperial guards filed in, their murderous aura filling the hall. "These men, from today onward, shall be at the Grand Tutor's disposal."

choices.description: Don't respond directly, instead ask about the Crown Prince's intelligence source, probing the forces behind him while observing the Crown Prince's reactions.
choices.risk_hint: If the Crown Prince is cautious, negotiations may break down

text.content: Unhurried, Chen Ji unfolded his folding fan, gave two light fans, and looked at the Crown Prince with an enigmatic smile: "Your Highness's information network is indeed well-developed. But this commoner is quite curious—did Your Highness personally uncover this intelligence, or was it 'kindly' delivered by someone?"

The Crown Prince's smile slightly faded, a sharp gleam flickering in his eyes: "The Grand Tutor is indeed prudent. Rest assured, though this prince's intelligence network is vast, no one else has intervened. As for how I learned—" he paused meaningfully, "the fragments of the Tianji Record are more than one in number."

choices.description: Pretend not to understand what the Crown Prince is saying, buying yourself time to think while secretly observing the Crown Prince's weaknesses.
choices.risk_hint: The Crown Prince has limited patience; opportunity for cooperation may be lost

text.content: Chen Ji blinked, his expression blank: "What Your Highness speaks, this commoner truly cannot understand. Tianqing Sect, Chen Ji... Could Your Highness have mistaken someone?" He made as if to take his leave, yet deliberately walked very slowly.

The Crown Prince coldly laughed, clapped his hands. The candles in the hall suddenly dimmed, and golden formation runes lit up beneath Chen Ji's feet, trapping him in place. "The Grand Tutor's performance is quite good. Unfortunately, this prince never speaks nonsense."

The Crown Prince waved his hand, and all attendants withdrew from the hall. In the vast bedchamber, only monarch and minister sat facing each other. The Crown Prince rose and paced to the window, gazing at the stars faintly visible in the night sky, his back revealing a steadiness unbecoming of his age.

dialogue.content: Does the Grand Tutor know that the thirty thousand imperial guards of this capital have all been replaced with this prince's trusted men?"

"Your Highness plays an excellent game. The Imperial Guard commander, the city gate officer, the patrol camp commander... these people must have been gathered into Your Highness's pocket long ago, correct?"

"Not only them." The Crown Prince turned around, a proud gleam appearing on his pallid face. "The chief eunuch beside His Majesty, the hidden agents of the Xuanwu Sect, the envoys of the Holy Sect of the Demonic Path—all their secrets, this prince knows thoroughly."

text.content: Chen Ji's heart shook. His gaze toward the Crown Prince finally changed. This seemingly frail heir apparent, with depths of cunning and breadth of planning, was not inferior to himself. He suddenly understood why his father had warned him in his testament not to underestimate the imperial family.

dialogue.content: The Crown Prince slowly approached Chen Ji, his gaze burning as he stared at him: "What this prince desires is not merely that seat."
Then what does Your Highness desire?"
The Crown Prince spoke word by word: "A truly unified realm. The days of sects standing in multitudes and feudal lords ruling independently must end. What this prince desires is—Great Unification."

choice.prompt: Faced with the Crown Prince's ambition, how does Chen Ji respond to this bargain?

choices.description: The Crown Prince's ambition highly aligns with one's own goals; completely accept the deal and form the closest alliance.
choices.visible_cost: Bear the debts of the dynasty
choices.visible_reward: Obtain authority over thirty thousand imperial guards
choices.risk_hint: If the Crown Prince turns against you, there will be no retreat

text.content: Chen Ji snapped his fan shut and clasped his hands: "Since Your Highness harbors such grand ambitions, this commoner is willing to serve. However—" he pivoted, "this commoner also has conditions for this deal."

The Crown Prince raised an eyebrow: "Speak your mind." Chen Ji raised three fingers: "First, after the destruction of the three great Sects, I want the complete inheritance of one sect as payment. Second, my family must receive the dynasty's protection. Third—" he lowered his voice, "Your Highness shall not inquire about the matter of the Tianji Record."

choices.description: Accept cooperation but set restrictive conditions, maintaining relatively independent status and freedom of action.
choices.visible_cost: Cannot fully command the imperial guards
choices.risk_hint: The Crown Prince may have reservations

text.content: Chen Ji pondered for a moment, then spoke: "Your Highness's grand ambitions, this commoner admires. However, regarding the cooperation method, we still need to discuss in detail."

The Crown Prince's brow slightly furrowed, but quickly smoothed: "The Grand Tutor is indeed prudent. Very well, this prince will not force it. As for cooperation details—you may freely command three thousand imperial guards. The rest, once the Grand Tutor has proven his worth."

choices.description: Don't passively accept the deal; instead, propose more conditions to the Crown Prince, demonstrating one's irreplaceability.
choices.risk_hint: If the Crown Prince turns hostile, may immediately tear up the agreement

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly laughed—that smile carried a subtle edge not easily察觉: "Your Highness may not be aware. This commoner's ability to survive between the three great Sects'夹缝 till today relies not merely on luck." He slowly paced, "Your Highness's layout is indeed exquisite, but—withdraw this commoner, and Your Highness's chess game will be delayed by at least three years."

The Crown Prince's expression slightly changed, but quickly returned to calm. He stared at Chen Ji for a long while, then suddenly burst into laughter: "Excellent! Excellent! Chen Ji! This prince indeed did not misjudge you!" He rose and struck the table, "Speak then, what do you want?"

The two debated intensely until late into the night, the candles in the hall having been replaced twice. Finally, a secret pact was drafted in the firelight—Chen Ji would secretly assist the Crown Prince under the title of "Grand Tutor," while the Crown Prince promised to grant Chen Ji the status and power equal to a Duke upon success.

The Crown Prince tucked the secret pact into a Hidden Compartment, then suddenly turned to look at Chen Ji, a meaningful gleam flickering in his eyes. That gaze was deep and complex, as if it could pierce through the deepest secrets of the human heart. Chen Ji's heart tightened; he felt there was something in those eyes he could not fathom.

dialogue.content: "Grand Tutor, I ask you one more time—are you truly prepared to walk this path? The gaze of the Heavenly Dao's Eye is no jest."
Chen Ji's pupils slightly contracted, yet his expression remained calm: "Does Your Highness also know of the Heavenly Dao's Eye?"

The Crown Prince gave no answer, only smiling meaningfully. He drew from his sleeve a golden token and handed it to Chen Ji: "This is this prince's personal token. If needed in the future, present this to meet this prince directly."

text.content: Chen Ji took the token; it was warm to the touch, with faint dragon patterns emerging. Just as he was about to take his leave, the Crown Prince suddenly spoke—that sentence struck like thunder, exploding in the silent bedchamber.

dialogue.content: "Grand Tutor, what this emperor desires has never been the throne, but rather—who this realm belongs to."

text.content: Chen Ji paused mid-step, turning back to look at the Crown Prince. That frail body now radiated an imposing manner overlooking all under heaven; those eyes burned with a certain almost fanatical fire. Chen Ji suddenly understood—this seemingly frail heir apparent, with ambitions so vast and vision so broad, far exceeded his imagination.

dialogue.content: "Your Highness carries tremendous ambition. In that case, this commoner is willing to accompany Your Highness on this journey."

text.content: Hearing this, a genuine smile finally appeared on the Crown Prince's pallid face. He extended his hand, and Chen Ji's hand tightly grasped it. Two hands equally hidden in the shadows finally formally allied at this moment. Outside the window, night winds suddenly rose, causing the hall's candles to flicker; the two figures' shadows overlapped on the wall, as if foreshadowing that future storm sweeping across the realm.

The moment Chen Ji stepped out of the bedchamber, a golden vertical pupil suddenly flickered in the depths of the Crown Prince's eyes—that vertical pupil was cold and高高在上, forming a eerie contrast with those病弱温和的眼睛。望着陈机离去的背影，the Crown Prince muttered to himself: "Interesting... The bearer of the Tianji Record, the piece of the Heavenly Dao's Eye... plus this prince's暗子, this chess game finally becomes entertaining." His lips curved into a meaningful arc, that smile hiding a depth even Chen Ji could not fathom.

When Chen Ji thought everything was under his control, what he didn't know was—that seemingly frail Crown Prince's eyes reflected a golden vertical pupil deep within, the mark of the Heavenly Dao's Eye. Above the imperial capital's night sky, dark clouds slowly shrouded the stars, an intangible oppression spreading in the darkness. The tranquility before a storm is often the most dangerous moment.
